description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaPipeline component, specifically testing media data handling, need data events, adding segments, and state transitions within the Rialto media pipeline. It uses Google Test framework and mocks to verify behavior of media segment processing, including encrypted frames and buffer management.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaPipelineDataTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for media pipeline data tests, setting up mocks, media pipeline, and test utilities.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates media pipeline, sets default state, and prepares shared memory info.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up resources, deletes frames, and destroys media pipeline after tests.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source with a specified source ID to the media pipeline.

methods.name: needDataGeneric
methods.description: Triggers a generic need data request with current source ID, frame count, request ID, and shared memory info.

methods.name: addFrames
methods.description: Adds a specified number of media frames (audio/video) with given data to the pipeline, mocking frame creation and writing.

methods.name: deleteFrames
methods.description: Deletes all stored media frames to free memory.

methods.name: haveDataSuccess
methods.description: Simulates successful 'have data' response from the pipeline.

methods.name: createFrame
methods.description: Creates a media segment (audio/video/unknown) with specified data and timestamp.

methods.name: startAddSegmentThread
methods.description: Starts a thread to simulate adding a media segment asynchronously.
